what_it_is.prose: TLMAL is the Tata-Lockheed Martin JV in Hyderabad that manufactures C-130J centre wing boxes, empennages, and fuselage components for the global C-130J programme. TLMAL was established in 2010 as part of the IAF C-130J offset programme and has delivered components for over 200 C-130J aircraft worldwide. TLMAL also manufactures S-92 helicopter cabins in partnership with Sikorsky.
